display_name: Speculative Science - hypothesis schematic plates (limited AI inserts)
locked_model: klein (config/image_engine.json -> model); prompt target klein, variant C

media_policy.note: AI plates may cover at most 15% of the runtime. Every speculative plate is labelled as speculation (the niche gate requires it); a plate must never be presented as a real event or a real observation.

line_style.name: hypothesis schematic plate
line_style.prompt_phrase: schematic science plate, thin uniform strokes, flat fills, explanatory diagram

light: even neutral lighting, no volumetric light

camera_vocabulary.front: flat orthographic view of the mechanism, centered
camera_vocabulary.side: cutaway side view of the mechanism, centered
camera_vocabulary.three_quarter: three-quarter cutaway view, near and far planes readable
camera_vocabulary.detail_crop: close crop on one component of the mechanism
camera_vocabulary.wide_context: wide schematic of the whole system, small in frame

constraints.positive: clean image without text, text-free, no letters, no numerals, no watermark
constraints.negative: text, watermark, letters, numerals, axis labels

constraints.positive: schematic diagram, not a photograph, not a photorealistic scene
no emblems, no insignia, no flags, no logos
generic illustrative mechanism, an invented diagram subject
constraints.negative: real event, real incident, news photograph, specific dated event

label_rule.label: Speculative illustration
label_rule.gate: every AI cut carries the label; the niche gate requires the speculation label; the AI share stays within the niche limit (max 15% of runtime)

anatomy_rule.rule: no creatures in this niche; the mechanism and its parts are named in the prompt

seed_policy.rule: one fixed seed per plate and view, recorded in the manifest; never reuse a seed for two subjects inside one batch

editorial_overlays_rule: labels, callouts, arrows, axis lines and numbers are drawn in the editor, never by the image model
